summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting the completion of a lock-up period for shares held by founders and major investors following a combination on May 12, 2026. It states that 15% of outstanding shares constitute the public float, with 85% subject to voluntary lock-up arrangements for at least twelve months. No transaction, acquisition, divestiture, or corporate action is being initiated or terminated. This is a routine post-combination update with no special-situation event, so the appropriate classification is None.
